newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Neogen buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Neogen buy repeated.

text.p: Roney & Co analyst Lynn Malkes reiterated her buy recommendation on Neogen Corp.
-She confirned her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate of $0.40 per share and her fiscal 1999 estimate of $0.52 per share.
-Neogen offers 140 separate disposable diagnostic test kits to detect natural toxins, drug and pesticide residues, foodborne bacteria, disease and infection, and quality measures.

"With an expanding product line in rapidly growing markets we believe Neogen represents a timely investment, and we recommend purchase for aggressive growth investors," Malkes wrote in a research note.
